# Antenna mast: a 2.4 m post on a footing, two crossbars, a top cap and a beacon light that pops on
# and off (rigid, constant keys: on for 6 of every 24 frames; off = shrunk into the cap). Up Z.
new
material new Mast --base-color 0.302 0.502 0.380
material new Foot --base-color 0.188 0.365 0.259 --no-slot
material new Beacon --base-color 0.933 1.0 0.8 --emission 0.933 1.0 0.8 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Foot --size 1 --location 0 0 0.1
scale 0.5 0.5 0.2
apply --scale
material assign Foot
add mesh cube --name Post --size 1 --location 0 0 1.25
scale 0.14 0.14 2.3
apply --scale
material assign Mast
add mesh cube --name BarA --size 1 --location 0 0 1.55
scale 0.7 0.12 0.12
apply --scale
material assign Mast
add mesh cube --name BarB --size 1 --location 0 0 2.0
scale 0.5 0.12 0.12
apply --scale
material assign Mast
add mesh cube --name Cap --size 1 --location 0 0 2.42
scale 0.24 0.24 0.12
apply --scale
material assign Foot
add mesh cube --name Light --size 0.2 --location 0 0 2.58
material assign Beacon
fps 24
frame range 0 24
select Light
set location 0 0 2.58
set scale 1 1 1
keyframe insert --channels loc,scale --frame 0
set location 0 0 2.42
set scale 0.05 0.05 0.05
keyframe insert --channels loc,scale --frame 6
set location 0 0 2.58
set scale 1 1 1
keyframe insert --channels loc,scale --frame 24
keyframe interpolation constant --all
frame set 0
select all
shade flat
export antenna.glb --bake-animations
